skill1: Deals 40.5% of final ATK as additional damage. Activates 5 times. — the "Activates 5 times" per-battle/per-trigger use cap is NOT modeled (the engine has no per-battle activation counter); the rider fires on every full-charge shot, which OVER-CREDITS if the cap is per battle.
skill2: Gentle Current: Fixes charge time at 1 sec continuously. Removes Raging Current. — requires a Rapture that is NOT the stage target; the solo-raid boss is the only enemy, so this branch can never activate and Raging Current is never removed.
Gains immunity to Increase Charge Speed effects. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.
Gains immunity to Decrease Charge Speed effects. This effect is continuous and cannot be removed.

caveats: ⚑ CHARGE-SPEED IMMUNITY IS UNMODELED AND IS THE LARGEST KNOWN ERROR SOURCE. Skill 2 grants permanent immunity to BOTH Increase and Decrease Charge Speed effects, so every ally charge-speed buff (Liter/Crown/most B1-B2 support, cube, and her own S1 charge-speed grant if she were ever its target) must be BLOCKED on this unit. The engine has no per-unit stat-immunity primitive, so any comp containing a charge-speed buffer will over-credit her shots/sec. Recipe: add a stat-immunity gate (per-unit StatKey denylist) in the buff engine, or run her only in charge-speed-free comps until then.

⚑ Her own S1 charge-speed grant targets 'the 1 Burst III ally with the lowest final ATK' — she is Burst III herself, so she can be her own target. If she is, the immunity above voids it. As authored, the engine will apply it to whichever B3 ranks lowest (possibly her); treat the self-target case as a known over-credit.

⚑ 'Raging Current' Attack Damage ▲231% is authored as PERMANENT-once-triggered (no durationSec) with first application on her first full charge landing on the boss. Steady state for the whole fight is therefore ~231% Damage-Up minus the pre-first-charge window (~chargeFrames/60 + latency ≈ 1.5-2s). Same-caster-slot overwrite means repeat applications are idempotent.

⚑ The 'Activates 5 times' cap on the 40.5% rider is unrepresentable; over a 180s fight she lands far more than 5 full charges, so this rider is a substantial over-credit if the cap is per battle rather than per trigger/stack.

⚑ 'Full Charge attack' triggers are modeled as `shotFired` because she is a charge weapon (chargeFrames 90) and every shot she fires is assumed to be a FULL charge. If she fires uncharged shots in practice, all three full-charge-gated blocks over-fire.
⚑ Charge cadence (chargeFrames 90, reloadFrames 141, ammo 6) is datamine-sourced and unverified against footage.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. SR/Wind/Attacker/Burst III charge unit. S1: FB-enter self ATK ▲160%/3s; a core-gated full-charge Attack Damage ▲20.83%/60s (self, effectively permanent after the first core landing given the 60s window and repeated refresh); a 40.5%-of-final-ATK full-charge rider on the target (capped at 5 activations in kit — cap NOT modeled); and an FB-enter Charge Speed ▲12.74% to the lowest-final-ATK Burst III ally. S2: the 'Raging Current' branch (full charge vs the STAGE TARGET) grants Attack Damage ▲231% continuously — in a solo raid the boss IS the stage target, so this branch is the only reachable one and Gentle Current can never fire; the two charge-speed immunity lines are documented-unmodeled (no engine primitive) and are the dominant known divergence in any charge-speed-buffed comp. Burst: self Attack Damage ▲50%/10s plus a 925%-of-final-ATK instant hit to all enemies (FB-exempt — a burst cast lands before the Full Burst window opens). Riders are authored crit-eligible at her sheet rate, no-range, and no-core (the text says 'additional damage', not 'core strike damage').

Core gate is explicit ('on a target's core'). 60s on a repeating trigger refreshes rather than stacks (no maxStacks in kit text ⇒ single instance, same-caster-slot overwrite).

audit.effectOrReason: shotFired → enemy → flatDamage atkPct 40.5, crit:true, noRange:true. No 'core strike' wording ⇒ no core. Rider takes FB by timing (default ON). ⚑ 'Activates 5 times' cap is unrepresentable — logged in unmodeled + caveats.

'12.74% of the skill user's Charge Speed' is a caster-scaled phrasing but the schema has no casterChargeSpeedPct; authored as a plain percentage — a known encoding approximation, flagged.

audit.effectOrReason: shotFired → self → buff attackDamagePct 231, NO durationSec ('continuously'). The solo-raid boss IS the stage target, so this is the reachable branch. Refreshes idempotently on every subsequent charge.
Mutual-exclusion bookkeeping between two named self states. Gentle Current is unreachable in this scope (single-enemy boss), so the removal is a no-op. Not a separate effect.
Requires a Rapture that is NOT the stage target. The scope-lock solo raid has exactly one enemy (the stage target), so this branch can never activate. Logged verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

audit.kitLine: Gentle Current: Fixes charge time at 1 sec
audit.effectOrReason: Body of the unreachable branch above. Also a stat CLAMP ('fixes charge time at') — a primitive the schema does not carry (engine-modeling-gaps: fixed-value clamps are distinct from percentage buffs).

audit.kitLine: Immunity to Increase Charge Speed effects
audit.effectOrReason: NO stat-immunity primitive exists in the schema — cannot block an incoming buff by StatKey. This is a WEAPON-STATE-relevant line (charge speed gates shots fired) and is therefore damage-relevant, not defensive: skipping it OVER-CREDITS her in any comp with a charge-speed buffer. Logged unmodeled + top caveat with an engine recipe.

audit.kitLine: Immunity to Decrease Charge Speed effects
audit.effectOrReason: Same missing primitive. In this scope (no boss charge-speed debuff modeled) this half is inert, so the net error from the immunity pair is one-directional: over-credit from unblocked ALLY charge-speed buffs.

audit.kitLine: Activates at the start of battle. Affects self.
audit.effectOrReason: Activation clause for the two immunity lines only; carries no effect of its own. Would map to trigger passive if the immunities were modelable.
burstCast → self → buff attackDamagePct 50, durationSec 10. Self buff in her OWN burst block ⇒ burstCast trigger (fires only on rotations SHE bursts), never fullBurstEnter.

audit.kitLine: All enemies. 925% of final ATK addl damage.
audit.effectOrReason: burstCast → enemy → flatDamage atkPct 925, crit:true, noRange:true, noFb:true. Burst-cast instant damage is always FB-exempt (the cast lands before the FB window opens) — per HARD RULE 9. 'All enemies' collapses to the single boss.

flags.estimate: UNMODELED (no primitive). Expected effect if modeled: her shots/sec becomes INVARIANT to ally charge-speed buffs; in a Liter/Crown-style comp this reduces her modeled full-charge count materially (order 10-25% fewer charges, depending on the comp's total charge-speed grant).
flags.reasoning: Charge speed gates shots fired ⇒ it is a damage mechanic, not a defensive one (HARD RULE: weapon-state modifiers ARE damage). The buff engine has no per-unit StatKey denylist, so ally chargeSpeedPct lands on her exactly as on anyone else. This is the single largest known divergence for this unit and it is comp-dependent, so it will masquerade as a magnitude error.
flags.recipe: Add a per-unit stat-immunity list to the override schema (e.g. `statImmunity: ['chargeSpeedPct']`) checked in the buff-apply path; then A/B her damage in a charge-speed-buffed comp with the immunity on vs off. Empirically: record one fight with a charge-speed buffer and one without, count her full-charge shots (ammo-counter / popup cadence) — if the counts match, the immunity is real and load-bearing.

flags.estimate: Authored UNCAPPED (fires on every full charge). If the cap is per battle, the modeled rider over-credits by roughly (total full charges / 5)× — on a 180s fight that is potentially 5-10× too much rider damage.
flags.reasoning: 'Activates 5 times' is ambiguous between (a) a per-battle activation cap, (b) 5 hits per activation (a multi-hit rider), and (c) 5 stacks of a counter. The schema has no per-battle activation counter, and no `hits` field on flatDamage. Reading (b) — 5 hits of 40.5% each per full charge — would instead mean the authored value is 5× TOO SMALL. The two readings differ by a factor of ~25-50 in total rider damage, so this is the highest-variance unknown in the file after the immunity.
flags.recipe: Read popups on a recorded fight: count how many 40.5%-magnitude hits appear per full-charge shot (reading b ⇒ 5 per shot, every shot) versus how many appear across the whole fight (reading a ⇒ exactly 5 total, then never again). One recording discriminates all three readings cleanly. Until then treat the rider's total contribution as unbounded-uncertain.

flags.reasoning: The kit says '12.74% OF THE SKILL USER'S Charge Speed' — a caster-scaled grant, structurally like casterAtkPct. The schema has no casterChargeSpeedPct, so the caster-scaling is lost and the value is applied as a flat percentage. If her own Charge Speed stat is near 100 (the usual base), the two encodings coincide; if it is materially different, the grant is mis-sized.
flags.recipe: Confirm the base Charge Speed stat scale in data/reference-stats.json; if base Charge Speed ≠ 100, either add a caster-scaled charge-speed StatKey or pre-multiply the authored value. Cross-check against another kit carrying the same 'of the skill user's Charge Speed' phrasing to see how it was encoded.

flags.field: override.skill1 / skill2 triggers — 'Full Charge attack' → shotFired
flags.estimate: Every shot she fires is a FULL charge (chargeFrames 90 ⇒ 1.5s charge + 22-frame release latency), so shotFired ≈ full-charge count 1:1.
flags.reasoning: The engine has no distinct full-charge trigger kind; shotFired is the only per-shot hook. For a charge weapon the sim fires only on completed charges, so the mapping should be exact — but this is an assumption about engine behavior, not a kit fact. If partial-charge shots exist, all four full-charge-gated blocks over-fire.
flags.recipe: Assert in scripts/tests/units/liberalio.test.ts that her shot-event count equals her full-charge count over a fixture run (count 'shot' events and compare to elapsed/(chargeFrames+latency+reload amortization)). The existing harness fixture is sufficient — no new footage needed.

flags.estimate: Effectively permanent from her first core-landing full charge (~2-4s in) through end of fight, given a 60s window refreshed by every subsequent core charge.
flags.reasoning: Kit-silent on stacking. Authored as a single refreshing instance (same-caster-slot overwrite). If the real mechanic stacks (kit lines that stack normally say so), this UNDER-credits; if her core rate is low, the buff may have gaps the model does not.
flags.recipe: Her core rate on the scope-lock boss is the gating unknown — an SR at scope-lock range should core near-always, but confirm from popup colours (red 'CORE HIT') on a recording. A test-side assertion on buffApply count for stat attackDamagePct value 20.83 pins the refresh-not-stack reading against the engine.

flags.reasoning: 'continuously' with the only removal condition (Gentle Current) unreachable in a single-enemy raid ⇒ permanent once on. The pre-first-charge dead window is the only deviation and is small but real (she also has no charge-speed buff to shorten it, by her own immunity).

This is a methodology rule, not a per-unit measurement, so it is a confident default rather than a true unknown — flagged only because per-kit noFb is on the ALWAYS-⚑ list.
